Exhibition name: Eridu Babylon
rows.Origin:
Bred by Robert Ilsink (Netherlands, before 2006).
Introduced in Japan by Keihan Hirakata Nursery in 2008 as 'Eridu Babylon'.
Introduced in Netherlands by Interplant BV in 2008 as 'Eridu Babylon'.
rows.Bloom: White, fuchsia / magenta edges, red center. Average diameter 1.5". Small, single (4-8 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
